list: The official 55 trophies, as published for launch on 2026-11-18

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are earned — there is no separate task. Follow the roadmap on this page: play the story first, meditate in Chapter 1 before it ends, pick up collectibles as you travel, then clean up activities and 100% completion after the finale.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to its end and the trophy pops when the mission completes. Nothing to prepare — just follow the mission prompts.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Finish every Chapter 1 story mission and the trophy pops at the chapter close. Before you leave Chapter 1, meditate on Lucia's balcony — that spot is tied to the one potentially missable trophy, Positive Mental Attitude, and may not come back.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Play through Chapter 2's story missions to the end of the chapter. The name is printed censored as 'T**s Ass Drug Money' by most lists; Press Start prints it uncensored, matching the line Dre'Quan says in the story.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Finish Chapter 3's story missions. Note the time-sensitive stranger race in this chapter, 'Race Against Yago' — it counts toward the Strangers & Freaks trophy, so take it when it appears rather than leaving it for later.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Play Chapter 4's story missions through to the chapter close. By now the map is fully open, so this is a good moment to sweep up collectibles and activities in areas you have unlocked.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy, and the gold one. Finish the final mission of the story. After it pops, the whole map stays open for cleanup — collectibles, stranger strands, challenges and 100% completion.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Complete the story mission Breakfast Run when it appears in the mission flow. It pops at the mission's end, like every other mission trophy.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions are longer, multi-stage jobs — follow the crew's plan, and the trophy pops when the job is done.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Complete the story mission Child's Play. It unlocks in the normal mission flow and pops on completion.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Complete the story mission Headliners. Just keep playing the story and it pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, set around Vice City International Airport. It pops when the mission is done.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. A late-story operation — finish it and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The second gold and the last trophy for most players. Reach 100% completion: finish the story, every stranger strand, the collectible sets, the counted activities and challenges. Watch the game's own completion percentage in the stats menu to see what is left, and save this trophy for last — it is the gate to the platinum.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: A grind, not a skill test. The game scores stunts — jumps, airtime, near misses and long drifts — as you drive and ride. You will bank a good share of the 250 just playing the story; after that, find a stretch of open road with ramps and jumps and chain stunts in a fast car or bike until the counter hits 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: A sampler trophy. Try one of every activity type the game offers — a race, the shooting range, fishing, bowling, an arcade game, a drone race and the rest. The trophy pops once you have sampled each type, so work through the list early and tick them off here as you go.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Visit a shooting range and work through its challenges one by one. Each challenge has a gold-medal score threshold — learn the target pattern first with a slow run, then go for gold with steady aim and controlled bursts instead of spraying. Every challenge must be gold, so replay the ones you miss until all of them are.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Find each Top Fun drone race location around Leonida and win a race at every one. Learn each course's turns on a practice run, then race clean — cutting corners and missing gates costs more time than a steady line saves.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 distinct races — the same race twice does not count twice. Work through the race types (street, off-road, boat and the rest) and pick a fast, well-handling vehicle for each. Replaying a lost race is free, so keep at the ones you lose.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Take on Cal's fishing challenge and out-fish him. Keep the line tension in the safe zone — reel steadily when the fish runs, ease off when it pulls hard — and land a bigger catch than Cal's to win the challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Find an arcade cabinet and play one game through to completion. Any arcade game counts — pick the one you are best at, finish a full round, and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: One of six stranger-finale trophies. Find Andy's stranger missions around Leonida and work through his strand to its last mission. Stranger strands stay available after the story, so there is no rush — but do not leave them all for the very end.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: One of six stranger-finale trophies. Follow Kenton's stranger mission strand to its final mission and complete it. Kenton's strand involves boats, fitting the name — finish the last job and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: One of six stranger-finale trophies. Work through Billy's stranger mission strand to its final mission. Billy's jobs are bike-flavoured — finish the strand and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete any 8 full stranger mission strands. Strangers are marked on the map as you explore — start a strand when you find one and see it through. Watch for the time-sensitive 'Race Against Yago' in Chapter 3 (shown with an hourglass icon): it counts toward this trophy, so take it when it appears. Any 8 strands count, so pick the ones you enjoy.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: One of six stranger-finale trophies. Follow Randy's stranger mission strand to its final mission and complete it. It also counts as one of the 8 strands for Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: One of six stranger-finale trophies. Work through Tyrone's stranger mission strand to its final mission. It also counts as one of the 8 strands for Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONE POTENTIALLY MISSABLE TROPHY — do this early. Meditate at every meditation spot in Leonida. Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 may disappear once Chapter 1 ends, and there is no mission replay, so meditate there during Chapter 1 and keep a separate Chapter 1 save as insurance. After that, meditate at each spot you find while exploring. Whether the Chapter 1 spot is strictly required is not yet proven — the safe play is to do it anyway.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — the exact animal and trigger are not yet pinned down by guide sites. Bret's stranger strand asks you to hunt a specific unique animal: follow his missions and hunt the animal he names when the hunt starts. Do not trust any single claimed location until the community confirms it.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Collectible cards are scattered around Leonida — in shops, on tables, in hideouts. Pick up cards as you explore and complete any 3 full sets to pop this. Cards stay available after the story, so sweep up the ones you missed during cleanup with a map checklist.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Open the WAiNK app on the in-game phone and 'WAiNK It' at 100 different locations. Any spot counts — landmarks, shops, beaches, viewpoints — so make it a habit: WAiNK It everywhere you stop while travelling. The counter is cumulative, so it builds up naturally over a full playthrough.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Work through the game's challenge list — driving, combat, exploration and stunt challenges, each with its own target. Check your challenge progress in the menu, pick the easiest unfinished ones first, and the 50th completion pops the trophy.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build the wanted level up to 4 stars, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear. Hide in an alley, a parking garage or the backstreets — stay out of the police cones on the minimap and wait for the search to cool off.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row while keeping the wanted level active the whole time — if the stars clear between robberies, the chain breaks. Plan a route with three close shops, move fast between them, and do not stop to fight the police until the third till is empty.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: A new vehicle model counts the first time you get into one. Drive everything you see — cars, bikes, boats, trucks — and vary your routes so you meet new models. Parking lots, dealerships and busy streets are the fastest way to find models you have not driven yet.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Trigger Combat Focus — the slow-motion aiming mode — in a firefight with at least five enemies close together, and drop all five before it ends. Pick a crowded shootout, aim for the head, and keep firing without letting the focus run out.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Head to Vice City International Airport, get into a plane and take off on your own terms — an 'unscheduled departure'. Stealing a plane from the tarmac and flying out of the airport is the read of the description; expect a wanted level on the way in, so go in fast and take off quickly.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description is a nod to the Rhino tank — get behind the wheel of one and drive it. Rhinos are military vehicles, so look for them around military sites and convoys, and be ready for a heavy police response once you take one.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Pick a jewelry store, case it first, and go in quiet — avoid the cameras and the staff's line of sight, take the goods, and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt fails, so leave and try again rather than fighting it out.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and get away clean each time. Each vault is its own job — crack it, grab the cash, and escape the wanted level before the next one counts. Plan your escape route before you go in, and do not stack vaults back-to-back with a hot wanted level.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Find an armored truck on the road, stop it — block it or shoot out its tires — take the cash, then escape the wanted level. Trucks spawn on highways and near banks; a sticky bomb or a well-placed ram gets the doors open.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Visit every region of Leonida until the whole map is revealed. Drive the highways end to end, then sweep the back roads, beaches and swamps. It builds up naturally across a full playthrough — if a corner of the map is still dark late in the game, drive there and the trophy will pop once the last area is covered.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Find and rob an illegal operation run by each of Leonida's gangs — one per gang. These are gang-run fronts and stash spots around the state; clear one for every gang and the trophy pops. Expect armed guards at each one.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — the exact venue and trigger are not yet pinned down by guide sites. The description is clear about the what: head to a bar or venue on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and enjoy the view. Try the beachfront bars in Vice City and stay for the drink — the trophy should pop once the moment registers.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — the exact showroom is not yet pinned down by guide sites. The description points to a classic move: drive a car through a vehicle showroom's frontage and smash your way out the other side. Pick a dealership with a glass front, build speed, and drive straight through.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and play a game through to the end — 'follow-through' means finishing the game, not just throwing one ball. A full game takes a few minutes; the trophy pops at the final frame.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — guide sites have not pinned down the exact requirement yet. The description hints at a partnership that draws a crowd, likely a social-media or follower milestone tied to playing with your partner. Check back once the community confirms the trigger; do not grind on a guess.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: A story-choice trophy. At a decision point in the story, make a significant choice — the trophy pops once the choice is made and the scene plays out. It is tied to the story's branching moments, so it comes from playing the story rather than free roam.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — the exact trigger is not yet pinned down by guide sites. The wording suggests failing at something once, then succeeding on the second attempt. Keep playing normally and it will likely pop on a retry; do not force it until the community confirms what counts.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — the exact trigger is not yet pinned down by guide sites. The description reads like a strange-encounter or easter-egg moment: something weird happens, and the trophy pops. Explore the odd corners of Leonida and keep an eye on community reports for the confirmed spot.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — the exact spot is not yet pinned down by guide sites. The description is a bowling joke: knock pins over with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — a drive-by with a bat or similar weapon, aimed at a set of pins. The bowling alley area is the natural place to try it.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked Bills come from robberies and heists — dirty cash you cannot spend directly. Launder them through your contacts until $250,000 is cleaned. Keep robbing and laundering through the playthrough; the total is cumulative, so it adds up across the whole game.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops — clothes, weapons, food, car mods, anything with a price tag. The total is cumulative, so it comes naturally over a full playthrough. Big purchases (a good car, a full weapon loadout) speed it up a lot.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy every garage property for sale across Leonida. Garages are marked for sale on the map and in property listings — work through them as your money allows. This pairs well with Treat Yo Self, since the purchases count toward your spending total.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Open the Scooter Bros app on the in-game phone and register 10 different vehicles to it. Any vehicle you drive counts — register each new one you pick up, and the 10th registration pops the trophy.
